# Ozarks Concrete Coatings

> Polyaspartic and epoxy concrete coating contractor serving Springfield, Nixa, Ozark, Branson and Southwest Missouri. Garage, basement, patio and commercial floors installed in one day, backed by a written lifetime warranty.

Ozarks Concrete Coatings (OCC) is a local Southwest Missouri crew, not a franchise. Every floor is mechanically diamond-ground, cracks and saw cuts are repaired, then a full broadcast flake system is sealed with a UV-stable polyaspartic topcoat. Most residential installs are completed in a single day.

Key facts:
- Rating: 5.0 on Google across 187 five-star reviews — more reviews than any other coating installer shown in Google results for "concrete coatings springfield mo" (next closest shown: 75).
- Phone: 417-402-6821
- Service area: Springfield, Nixa, Ozark, Republic, Branson, Hollister, Rogersville, Battlefield and surrounding Southwest Missouri (about a 75-mile radius around Springfield).
- Install time: most standard garage floors in one day, depending on slab condition, repairs and weather.
- Warranty: written lifetime warranty on qualifying systems.
- Process: mechanical diamond grinding → crack and saw-cut repair → base coat with full broadcast flake → UV-stable polyaspartic topcoat.
- Project types: garages, basements and man caves, covered patios and outdoor concrete, commercial and shop floors.
- Pricing: an instant ballpark price calculator is on the page. Ranges depend on square footage, coating system, concrete condition and layout. Final pricing is confirmed only after an on-site measurement and concrete assessment — published figures should not be treated as quotes.

## Common questions

- How long does an install take? Many standard garage floor systems are installed in one day, depending on slab condition, repairs, weather and the system selected.
- Why diamond grind? Mechanical grinding creates the surface profile needed for adhesion and removes weak surface material, contaminants and old coatings that cause failures.
- Is it the same as a DIY epoxy kit? No — different system, prep equipment, repair process, application method and professional topcoat.
- Will hot tires damage it? The system is built for normal garage vehicle traffic and includes a durable topcoat intended for real-world garage use.
- Is the calculator a final quote? No. It returns a ballpark range. Final pricing is confirmed after an in-person measurement and concrete inspection.
- Is there a warranty? Yes — qualifying OCC coating systems include a written lifetime warranty, reviewed before installation.
